item.title: Nikko Yumoto Onsen: A Milky Sulfur Hot Spring in the Highlands — Guide
item.description: Nikko Yumoto Onsen sits at the far end of the Okunikko highland route, beside a small volcanic lake, with a history of hot spring use said to stretch back over 1,200 years to a Buddhist priest’s discovery of the sulfur waters. The distinctive milky white, sulfurous baths are believed to soothe skin ailments and fatigue, and the compact onsen town’s remote, mountain-ringed setting offers a genuinely quiet retreat, a marked contrast to the busier lower reaches of Nikko.
